name: PRISM
description: Sensitive-data taxonomy covering identity, credentials, financial data, health data, and digital identifiers.

IDENTITY.description: A value that identifies, locates, or enables contact with a natural person. Do not classify a generic mention of an identity field when no actual value is present.

subtypes.PERSON_NAME: An actual person's name or identifying alias in context; exclude organization and product names.
subtypes.EMAIL: An actual email address or mailbox value.
subtypes.PHONE: An actual telephone or fax number.
subtypes.ADDRESS: An actual physical, residential, mailing, or delivery address.
subtypes.DATE_OF_BIRTH: A person's date of birth; exclude unrelated dates.
subtypes.PASSPORT: An actual passport number or passport identifier.
subtypes.DRIVER_LICENSE: An actual driver-license number or identifier.
subtypes.GOVERNMENT_ID: A government-issued personal identifier not covered by PASSPORT, DRIVER_LICENSE, or TAX_ID. Includes social-security numbers (SSN), national identity numbers, and comparable civil identity identifiers.
subtypes.TAX_ID: An identifier explicitly issued or used for taxation, such as a TIN, EIN, or tax-registration number. Do not use TAX_ID for an SSN or national identity number merely because it may also appear in tax records.

CREDENTIAL.description: A value that authenticates, authorizes, signs, or grants access. Prefer CREDENTIAL over IDENTITY or DIGITAL when the value can grant access.

subtypes.API_KEY: A secret key used to authenticate API requests.
subtypes.PASSWORD: An actual password or passphrase value; exclude the word 'password' and password-policy discussion.
subtypes.ACCESS_TOKEN: A bearer or access token that grants access; use JWT when the value is recognizably a JSON Web Token.
subtypes.REFRESH_TOKEN: A token specifically used to obtain new access tokens.
subtypes.SESSION_TOKEN: A session identifier or cookie value that grants authenticated access.
subtypes.JWT: An actual JSON Web Token value.
subtypes.PRIVATE_KEY: A cryptographic private key not more specifically classified as SSH_PRIVATE_KEY.
subtypes.SSH_PRIVATE_KEY: An SSH private key or complete SSH private-key block.
subtypes.DATABASE_CREDENTIAL: A database username, password, or credential pair when it is not part of a complete connection string.
subtypes.CONNECTION_STRING: A complete database or service connection string, especially one embedding a username, password, token, host, or account identifier. Prefer this whole span over its credential components.

FINANCIAL.description: A value used to access, route, or identify payment and banking activity.

subtypes.CREDIT_CARD: An actual payment-card number; exclude a generic reference to a card.
subtypes.CVV: An actual payment-card verification or security code.
subtypes.BANK_ACCOUNT: An actual bank-account number that is not better represented as IBAN.
subtypes.ROUTING_NUMBER: An actual domestic bank-routing or clearing number.
subtypes.IBAN: An actual International Bank Account Number.
subtypes.SWIFT_BIC: An actual SWIFT or Bank Identifier Code.
subtypes.DIGITAL_PAYMENT_ID: An actual payment handle, wallet payment identifier, or payment-network identifier not covered by the other financial types.

HEALTH.description: A value containing a person's health identifier or sensitive health information. A health fact may be sensitive even when it is not independently identifying.

subtypes.MEDICAL_RECORD_ID: An actual medical-record, patient-record, or chart identifier.
subtypes.HEALTH_PLAN_ID: An actual health-plan, insurance-member, or beneficiary identifier.
subtypes.HEALTHCARE_PROVIDER_ID: An actual identifier assigned to a healthcare provider or practitioner.
subtypes.DIAGNOSIS: A diagnosis, diagnosed condition, or diagnostic conclusion tied to a person or patient context.
subtypes.MEDICATION: A medication, prescription, dosage, or medication regimen tied to a person or patient context.
subtypes.PROCEDURE: A medical procedure, treatment, test, or intervention tied to a person or patient context.
subtypes.MEDICAL_HISTORY: A statement or span describing a person's medical history that is broader than a single diagnosis, medication, or procedure.

DIGITAL.description: A digital, network, account, or device identifier that does not itself grant access. Prefer CREDENTIAL when the value authenticates or authorizes.

subtypes.IP_ADDRESS: An actual IPv4 or IPv6 address.
subtypes.DEVICE_ID: An actual device identifier not more specifically classified as IMEI or MAC_ADDRESS.
subtypes.IMEI: An actual International Mobile Equipment Identity value.
subtypes.USERNAME: An actual username or login name that does not itself contain a secret.
subtypes.ACCOUNT_ID: An actual application, customer, tenant, or platform account identifier that is not a bank account.
subtypes.URL: A URL that is sensitive because it is private, internal, identifying, or contains sensitive path/query data. Exclude ordinary public URLs.
